title: Asking always shows the Agent area, even from a closed panel or a video in View
goal: When a person sends a request to Ask, they always see the Agent area with its new row: a closed panel opens, a folded Agent group unfolds and scrolls into view, and a video in View shows it too.
notes: The user, 2026-10-20: 'when i ask something, but the left pane is minimized or a video is not in edit mode, we need to reveal what we need to in order for the agent pane to be visible.' (They said left; the Agent group is in the right panel. Reveal whichever pane holds it.) Filed at first as an acceptance line on ask-makes-the-change-straight-away-and-each-chan, but that task closed nine minutes earlier, so it gets its own task. Today AskSession.ask bumps revealPass (Sources/Photonz/Agent/AskSession.swift) and only InspectorPanel.swift:560 listens, scrolling to the Agent section, which does nothing when the panel is not on screen.
acceptance: Asking from each of these at Next defaults brings the Agent group into view with the new row: panel closed, Agent group folded, Agent group scrolled away, a video in View (switch to Edit, or show the Agent area in View; decide and log), on a picture and on a video
Nothing else about the layout the person chose changes for good: closing the panel again keeps it closed next time

A walk per starting state, with a picture of each in the audit under queue/audits/. Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Reproduced first: a walk that closes the panel, asks, and looks for the Agent group failed with the group nowhere in the window (the composer closed, the panel stayed shut). The old reveal only scrolled a panel that was already up.

Chose switching a video in View to Edit over showing the Agent area in View because View has no panel by design and every other edit made from View (setInspectorVisible, switchToEditForAnEdit) already switches to Edit.

Chose bringing the panel out for this window only (isLayersPanelVisible, never inspectorPreferredVisible) so a person who keeps it closed gets a closed panel in the next window; closing it again writes their choice as before. Rule in PhotonzCore/AskReveal.swift, tested in AskRevealTests.

Built: EditorState+AskReveal.swift brings the area out; AskSession.ask calls it and arms isRevealPending; InspectorPanel reveals on appear too and looks four times (0.08 to 1.2s) so a panel still arriving with Edit is caught. Named the working row and Stop (Agent Working, Agent Stop) for walks.

Five walks, all green: closed panel, folded (front: true, a header click only folds in front), scrolled away (1280x560 with a box picked), video in View, video in View with the panel closed. Scripts/test.sh: 14057 tests passed.

Looked at audit pictures 2, 4, 6, 8, 9: each shows the Agent group with its Working row on screen; 8 and 9 show the window in Edit. Picture 6 has a blank band at the top of Appearance that also shows with no ask: filed as find-out-whether-panel-rows-go-blank-after-the-p (p2, not reproduced by hand). Title bar crowding on a video folded into on-a-video-the-ask-button-never-sits-on-top-of-t (already covers it).

Asking now always shows the Agent group with its working row: a closed panel comes out (this window only, the person's choice for new windows untouched), a folded group unfolds, a scrolled-away one scrolls back, a video in View switches to Edit. AskReveal rule in PhotonzCore with tests; EditorState+AskReveal and a retrying InspectorPanel reveal. Five ask-shows-the-agent-group walks green at Next defaults, Scripts/test.sh 14057 passed, audit queue/audits/2026-10-20-ask-reveal.json. Commit ee9fc70b.
